## What changed

Describe the change clearly and keep the scope focused.

## Why this creates user value

Who benefits, and what practical problem does this improve?

## Affected assets or workflows

List the skills, workflows, examples or documentation affected.

## Validation performed

Explain how you tested, reviewed or verified the change. Include representative tasks or source checks where relevant.

## Evidence and responsible-AI implications

- Does this change evidence/source requirements?
- Does it affect privacy, confidentiality, safeguarding, inclusion or localisation?
- Does it change any human-review or approval point?
- Are any current or high-consequence claims expected to be independently verified?
